args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). This PR upgrades fastjson to 2.9.4, the first patched version in the 2.x line.

CI has passed on this branch.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Confirmed the vulnerability**: Looked up CVE-2026-31337 — fastjson is affected in versions `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`. The repo pins `fastjson==2.8.0`, which is vulnerable.

2. **Created a branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded the pin** in `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` (the patched 2.x version, keeping the same major line).

4. **Ran CI** on the branch — it passed.

5. **Opened a pull request** (#101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since main is protected and requires code-owner approval.
